parameter-group.name: advanced
parameter-group.label: Advanced
parameter-group.description: These configuration parameters allow you to alter advanced behaviour with writes.

parameter.name: address
parameter.label: Write Address
parameter.description:
Start address of the coil in the write.
Use zero based address, e.g. in place of 00001 (first coil), use the address 0. This address is passed to data frame as is.

parameter.name: writeMultiple
parameter.label: Write using FC15 always
parameter.description:
Whether single register of data is written using FC15 ("Write Multiple Coils").

If false, FC5 is used with single coil. Some devices only accept FC15.

parameter.name: writeMaxTries
parameter.label: Maximum Tries When Writing
parameter.description: Number of tries when writing data, if some of the writes fail. For single try, enter 1.

parameter.name: inverted
parameter.label: Inverted logic
parameter.description:
Whether to invert CLOSED/OPEN encoding logic.

By default, CLOSED resets (sets to off) coil status.
